column1: My wheat leaves are turning yellow, what should I do?
column2: This usually means nitrogen deficiency. Apply urea fertilizer in split doses and avoid overwatering.

column1: Best time to sow cotton in Gujarat?
column2: Cotton sowing is best done between April and June, after pre-monsoon showers.

column1: How to control aphids on chili plants?
column2: Spray neem oil solution (5ml per liter water) every 7 days. In severe cases use imidacloprid.

column1: When should I apply DAP fertilizer?
column2: Apply DAP at the time of sowing, mixed into the soil near the root zone.

column1: My plant leaves have white powder on them, what is it?
column2: This is likely powdery mildew, a fungal disease. Spray sulfur-based fungicide.

column1: How often should I water groundnut crop?
column2: Water every 10-12 days, avoid waterlogging as it can cause root rot.

column1: What causes root rot in plants?
column2: Overwatering and poor soil drainage. Improve drainage and reduce watering frequency.

column1: Best season to sow wheat?
column2: Wheat is best sown between October and December in most parts of India.

column1: How to control whitefly in cotton?
column2: Use yellow sticky traps and spray neem oil or imidacloprid-based pesticide.

column1: My tomato plants have spots on leaves, what should I do?
column2: This could be early blight. Remove affected leaves and spray copper-based fungicide.

column1: When to use urea fertilizer?
column2: Apply urea 20-25 days after sowing, and again during flowering stage, in split doses.

column1: How to improve poor soil quality?
column2: Add organic compost or farmyard manure, and consider crop rotation to restore nutrients.

column1: What is the right time for soil testing?
column2: Test soil before every sowing season, ideally once a year, to check nutrient levels.

column1: How to control caterpillar attack on crops?
column2: Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) based bio-pesticide or use recommended chemical insecticide.

column1: Best time to sow groundnut?
column2: Groundnut sowing is ideal between June and July, at the start of monsoon.

column1: My plant growth is very slow, what to do?
column2: Could be nutrient deficiency. Apply balanced NPK fertilizer and ensure proper watering.

column1: How to control termites in field?
column2: Apply chlorpyrifos near root zones or use neem cake as an organic alternative.

column1: What is the right irrigation method to save water?
column2: Drip irrigation saves up to 40-50% water compared to flood irrigation.

column1: When should I apply pesticide after sowing?
column2: Apply preventive pesticide spray 15-20 days after sowing, then as needed based on pest activity.

column1: My crop has too much salt in soil, what to do?
column2: Add gypsum to reduce soil salinity and improve drainage. Flush field with fresh water if possible.
